deviation: The draft lets the SOW override the Parent Agreement whenever it expressly states so for a specified provision, which the playbook doesn't allow. The SOW could then dilute MSA liability, IP, data protection or audit terms. The draft also leaves out the express statement that those MSA terms (liability, indemnity, IP, confidentiality, data protection, audit, governing law) apply to the SOW.
suggested_text: 1.3 This SOW is issued under, and governed by, the Master Services Agreement (the Parent Agreement). If there is a conflict between this SOW and the Master Services Agreement, the Master Services Agreement prevails over this SOW. The liability, indemnity, intellectual property, confidentiality, data protection, audit and governing law terms of the Master Services Agreement apply to this SOW.
